title: Project Budget Allocation
description: An enterprise development team has a list of feature point costs and a target budget limit. Each feature cost can only be utilized once in a single project configuration, and the available feature costs may contain duplicate values. Find all unique combinations of feature costs that sum up to the exact target budget.
input_format: An array of integers costs and an integer target.
output_format: A list of lists containing all unique combinations that sum to target.

examples.explanation: The combinations that sum up to 8 are found without reusing the exact same element index twice and without duplicate combinations.
The available numbers allow combinations that equal the target 5.
Choosing unique elements by index ensures only distinct lists are generated.
